subject: [PATCH v6 11/19] selftests/mm: add order-parameterized khugepaged collapse cases

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds four new test cases to the khugepaged selftest suite, specifically designed to check how khugepaged handles different window collapse scenarios when the order parameter is used. The new cases cover various edge cases such as a single populated window collapsing, a partial window collapsing with max_ptes_none enabled, a full window collapsing with max_ptes_none disabled, and mixed sources collapsing to the target order. Each case faults its region before MADV_HUGEPAGE with only the target order enabled, allowing khugepaged to handle the collapse. The test cases are designed to ensure that khugepaged behaves correctly in these scenarios, which were previously not adequately tested.
